description: agent_wakes — the agent-scheduled resumption store (agov-wake-01). One row per self-suspension, state machine pending -> due -> fired (or cancelled), enforced by conditional UPDATE in tools/agent_runtime/wake.py rather than by a CHECK or a trigger. MUTABLE state, deliberately NOT append-only: the permanent record of what the agent did after waking lives in the existing append-only trails. Distinct from agent_cron_jobs (migration 289), which is operator-declared and recurring.
author: icdev-builder
reversible_note: down.sql drops the table and its four indexes. No evidence is lost, but every unspent wake is: an agent suspended on a timer, job or event will never be resumed after a rollback, and nothing reports it.
